questions.stem: A product catalog needs exact codes and semantic candidates, with optional semantic reranking. Which TWO statements describe the stages correctly? Select TWO answers.

options.text: Hybrid retrieval combines keyword and vector ranked lists.
Semantic ranking renames source fields during ingestion.
Semantic reranking generates the indexed vectors.
A query vectorizer uses a compatible embedding configuration.
Keyword sorting makes vectorization unnecessary for the vector path.

explanation.whyCorrect: Hybrid retrieval combines complementary lists. Query vectorization supplies the vector path; semantic reranking operates after candidate retrieval.

whyDistractorsWrong.C: Reranking does not produce stored embeddings.
whyDistractorsWrong.B: Field mapping is an ingestion concern.
whyDistractorsWrong.E: A vector query still requires compatible vectorization.

sourceRefs.title: Hybrid search using vectors and full-text search in Azure AI Search

questions.stem: A document enrichment pipeline needs layout-aware Markdown and OCR for normalized images. Which TWO skill choices directly target these outputs? Select TWO answers.

options.text: The OCR skill receiving normalized images.
The Document Intelligence Layout skill.
A semantic query configuration.
An output field alias without a producing skill.
An Azure OpenAI chat output-token setting.

explanation.whyCorrect: Layout and OCR are producing enrichment capabilities. Their outputs still need the appropriate index mappings.

whyDistractorsWrong.C: Query semantics do not extract document layout.
whyDistractorsWrong.E: Generation length does not configure enrichment skills.
whyDistractorsWrong.D: A mapping does not create an absent enrichment output.

questions.stem: An agent retrieves an unrelated Search index and returns content from another department. Which TWO tool configuration controls address the stated defects? Select TWO answers.

options.text: A resource name containing the department.
A supported filter using the authorized department.
A larger unfiltered candidate set.
The correct connected index name.
A longer model answer.

explanation.whyCorrect: Select the intended index and enforce the supported retrieval filter. The authorized field value comes from the host’s access context.

whyDistractorsWrong.E: Length does not change retrieved data.
whyDistractorsWrong.A: A display name does not filter documents.
whyDistractorsWrong.C: More unfiltered candidates leave the boundary defect.

questions.stem: A document pipeline must extract invoice fields and support amount verification. Which TWO design choices address those requirements? Select TWO answers.

options.text: Retain source locations for reviewer inspection.
Treat high confidence as permission to pay.
Replace field types with filename parsing.
Define the required field schema.
Discard coordinates after assigning confidence.

explanation.whyCorrect: The schema defines extraction targets; grounding locations connect extracted values to the source. Downstream payment validation is separate.

whyDistractorsWrong.C: A filename does not supply typed document fields.

questions.stem: A RAG pipeline needs a clean document representation before retrieval. Which TWO Content Understanding outputs or behaviors fit? Select TWO answers.

options.text: A completed analysis result consumed after successful polling.
Markdown representing document structure.
A generated final answer used as the source document.
A queued operation treated as extracted text.
A raw poller serialized into the vector field.

explanation.whyCorrect: Structured/Markdown extraction and completed analysis results support downstream processing. An operation handle is not the extracted representation.

whyDistractorsWrong.D: Queued work has not yielded a completed representation.
whyDistractorsWrong.C: A final answer is downstream generation rather than the source representation.
whyDistractorsWrong.E: The poller is control state, not an embedding vector.

questions.stem: A custom contract analyzer misses renewal dates in a new layout. Which TWO inputs should guide improvement? Select TWO answers.

options.text: A typed renewal-date field definition.
A high threshold reported as proof of correctness.
Renaming every unrelated date as renewal_date.
Tune the query semantic configuration without changing the extraction field definition.
Representative examples with verified values.

explanation.whyCorrect: Define the intended field and use representative labeled evidence to improve extraction. Evaluate results on separate documents.

whyDistractorsWrong.D: Query ranking cannot define the missing renewal-date extraction target.
whyDistractorsWrong.C: Renaming an unrelated date does not identify the business field.
whyDistractorsWrong.B: A confidence threshold is not verification.

questions.stem: An agent proposes a refund. The application requires user confirmation, and the model supplies untrusted arguments. Which TWO host responsibilities are needed before the side effect? Select TWO answers.

options.text: Obtain confirmation for the specific proposed refund.
Return the payment credential to the model for approval checking.
Execute the refund before displaying its confirmation dialog.
Validate the arguments and authorize the target account.
Treat valid JSON as sufficient permission to issue the refund.

explanation.whyCorrect: The host must validate and authorize the operation, then obtain confirmation before executing that approved proposal.

whyDistractorsWrong.E: Syntax does not establish authorization or approval.
whyDistractorsWrong.C: Confirmation would occur after the side effect.
whyDistractorsWrong.B: The host should keep secrets out of tool results.

questions.stem: A strict Responses output must contain code and comment. Comment may be null, and additional fields are prohibited. Which TWO schema decisions satisfy those constraints? Select TWO answers.

options.text: Allow arbitrary extra fields and validate just the required names.
Keep comment required and allow its type to include null.
Represent absent comment as an omitted property with no nullable type.
Set additionalProperties to false on the object schema.
Omit comment from required when its value is unavailable.

explanation.whyCorrect: Use required nullable fields for optional information and disallow additional properties. The supported strict subset treats presence and nullability separately.

whyDistractorsWrong.E: The contract requires the property to be present.
whyDistractorsWrong.C: That changes both presence and value semantics.

questions.stem: A RAG system must find exact equipment identifiers and semantic paraphrases. It uses a vector index built with model X. Which TWO design choices fit? Select TWO answers.

options.text: Use an unrelated model with matching dimensions as proof of vector compatibility.
Sort hybrid candidates by filename after RRF to preserve relevance.
Replace embeddings with semantic reranking during ingestion.
Use query embeddings compatible with the indexed model X vectors.
Combine keyword and vector retrieval through hybrid search.

explanation.whyCorrect: Hybrid retrieval supplies complementary lexical and semantic signals. Vector relevance also depends on compatible query and content representations.

whyDistractorsWrong.A: Dimension equality does not establish a shared representation.
whyDistractorsWrong.C: Reranking does not generate stored vectors.
whyDistractorsWrong.B: Filename order is not relevance ranking.

questions.stem: An agent receives hostile user prompts and malicious instructions inside retrieved text. Which TWO controls align with those different entry points? Select TWO answers.

options.text: Treat retrieved-document instructions as lower-trust indirect attacks.
Approve retrieved instructions because the source URL uses HTTPS.
Scan final answers as proof that proposed tool calls were safe before execution.
Treat tool output as a new developer message when it names a system role.
Assess direct user attacks at the input boundary.

explanation.whyCorrect: User input and retrieved content create different attack paths. Apply controls at the relevant boundaries and preserve instruction authority.

whyDistractorsWrong.D: Text inside a result does not acquire a privileged role.
whyDistractorsWrong.B: Transport security does not establish instruction authority.
whyDistractorsWrong.C: A final scan occurs after earlier tool actions.
